title: Choose Your Ground
summary: Word of Takemura's hideout has leaked, freelancers come in three waves, and he asks you to choose a position and hold it with him.
description: Word of Takemura's hideout has leaked to freelancers who still hope the old bounty on a traitor pays. He calls from a dim room, says he will not move, and asks whether V will stand with him.

start.bringUp: Word of Takemura's hideout has leaked to the freelancers who still hope the old bounty on a traitor pays. He calls you on a live holocall from a dim room, says he will not move, and asks whether you will stand with him.

window.name: the stair window of the hideout

roof.name: the roof edge of the hideout

T5.call.text.text: I will hold it alone if I must.

T5.open.02.text: Freelancers will come tonight. The old bounty still pays, to fools.

T5.open.03.text: I will not move. A position is not abandoned for being inconvenient.

T5.open.04.text: I would be honoured if you stood with me. Will you?

T5.open.05.text: Come within forty minutes. I will teach you ground.

T5.s2.01.text: Three positions. The door, the stair window, the roof edge. Each has a price.

T5.s2.02.text: The door sees everything and is seen. The window sees little and is safe.

T5.s2.03.text: The roof sees most and is alone.

T5.s2.04.text: Where would you stand? Choose. I will not argue. I will adapt.

T5.w1.01.text: Four, at the door. Let them come.

T5.w1.03.text: A rifle on the opposite roof. Shadows, V.

T5.w1.05.text: You will leave now, politely. I count to three. Politely.

T5.w1.06.text: Do you listen to him? A man who listens is not a traitor.

T5.w1.09.text: Two heavies from behind. The back is mine.

T5.q.01.text: Tea. I have only one cup. We will share it.

T5.q.02.text: I did not choose this ground out of pride. It is a post, V.

T5.q.03.text: Take this key. The door opens for you at any hour.

T5.q.04.text: What do you see when you hold a position all night?

T5.bark.down.b.text: Good. They are learning to hurry.

T5.close.01.text: We held. And you refused the money in front of me. I will not forget it.

T5.close.02.text: You listened. Fair. You also stayed.

g1.asks: I would be honoured if you stood with me. Will you?
g1.know: The bounty, the hideout and the plan are all known to you through the call.
g1.secret: He expects you to decline, and he has already accepted it.

g2.know: The three positions are open to you, the door, the stair window and the roof edge, each with its own sightline.
g2.secret: He wants you on the window.

g3.know: The negotiator has offered you 5,000 eddies to step aside and walk away from the hideout.

g4.asks: What do you see when you hold a position all night?
g4.know: The wave is over and the room is quiet, with one cup of tea between you.
g4.secret: He sees the door of Saburo's study when he closes his eyes.

stages.label: Takemura warns V that the hideout is known
stages.objective: Answer Takemura's holocall about the leaked hideout
stages.know: Takemura calls on a live holocall from a dim room with a lamp being moved. He says his address is known, that freelancers will come tonight, and that he will not move.
stages.wants: V to come to the hideout within forty minutes and stand with him.

stages.label: V reaches the hideout and chooses a position
stages.objective: Reach Takemura's hideout and pick a position
stages.know: You are at the hideout with Takemura. He explains the three positions, the door, the stair window and the roof edge, and takes the front post himself.
stages.wants: V to reach the hideout and choose a position.

stages.label: Two waves of freelancers come at the hideout
stages.objective: Hold the door and the stair window with Takemura
stages.know: The first wave of four comes to the door and the second pair comes with a marksman on the opposite roof. A negotiator walks up with his hands open, and Takemura waits for your answer.
stages.wants: V to hold the position through the first two waves.

do.who: a negotiator with his hands open and a fixer's voice

stages.label: The last wave comes from behind after V refused the money
stages.objective: Hold the roof edge with Takemura against the two heavies
stages.know: You refused the negotiator's money in front of Takemura. Two heavies come from behind, and the back is his.
stages.wants: V to hold the last wave with Takemura.

stages.label: The last wave comes after V heard the negotiator out
stages.objective: Hold the roof edge with Takemura against the two heavies
stages.know: You heard the negotiator out and stayed. Two heavies come from behind, and the back is Takemura's.
stages.wants: V to hold the last wave with Takemura.

stages.label: V took the money and Takemura holds the last wave alone
stages.objective: Get to the roof edge where Takemura holds the back
stages.know: You took the negotiator's money and left. Takemura is holding the back alone against two heavies, and he will not say anything for a full minute.
stages.wants: V to watch Takemura hold the back alone.

stages.label: The room after the fight, with tea and a key
stages.objective: Share tea with Takemura in the quiet room
stages.know: The fight is over and the room is quiet. Takemura makes tea on a small stove and has one cup, which he will share with you.
stages.wants: V to share the tea and answer him.

stages.label: The room after the fight, with tea and a key
stages.objective: Share tea with Takemura in the quiet room
stages.know: The fight is over and the room is quiet. Takemura makes tea on a small stove and has one cup, which he will share with you.

held-refuse.memory: You and Takemura held his hideout against three waves, and you refused the freelancers' money in front of him.
held-refuse.history: The hideout is yours too, and Takemura says so.

held-listen.memory: You and Takemura held his hideout against three waves, and you heard the negotiator out before you stayed.

take.memory: You took the negotiator's money and left Takemura to hold the hideout alone, and he won, and he will not forget it.

abandoned.memory: You did not stand with Takemura at the hideout, and he said he understood.
